params.name: country
params.description: Specify the country code of the alerts request. This is a required parameter. The reference for acceptable values is ISO 3166 two-letter codes (alpha-2).

params.name: lat
params.description: The latitude in decimal degrees. When specified, it must be used together with the `lon` parameter. This parameter can also be used with the `radius` parameter. This parameter cannot be used with the `country` or the `bbox` parameters.

params.name: lon
params.description: The longitude in decimal degrees. When specified, it must be used together with the `lat` parameter. This parameter can also be used with the `radius` parameter. This parameter cannot be used with the `country` or the `bbox` parameters.

params.name: radius
params.description: The radius in km. When specified, alerts intersecting the circle with the POINT(`lon`,`lat`) as the center will be returned.This parameter cannot be used with the `country` or the `bbox` parameters.

params.name: bbox
params.description: The bounding box coordinates in the format `minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat`. This parameter cannot be used with the `country` or the `lat/lon/radius` parameters.

params.name: language
params.description: Specify the language to use in the text values of the alert. Values should follow RFC 3066.

params.name: agency
params.description: Specify the agency of the alert request.

params.name: event
params.description: When specified, the API will return only alerts that match the specified event types.

params.name: excludeGeometry
params.description: Specify whether or not to include the root geojson geometry for each alert.

This endpoint returns the latest active weather bulletins from the requested national meteorological agency. 
It is the primary source of information for real-time weather alerts and updates.

Understanding and Utilizing Key Query Parameters:
- **country:** 
Use this parameter to access all active weather bulletins within a specific country.
